title: 第25章 养伤第26章 坏消息
lines: 该劝的劝完，该说的也说完了，吴厚默默离开，给吴谦留出足够空间，让他冷静。
吴谦确实有点懵，所以连吴吴厚离开，都忘了打招呼。
自从醒来之后，他只知道日日夜夜疼的钻心，但从没看过伤口。
怕受不了视觉冲击的刺激。
听了吴厚的话，吴谦心思活动了。
要正视自己，正视伤疤！
做好心理建设后，吴厚目视前方，缓缓掀开前摆，
慢慢解开裤带，
轻轻放开外裤，
微微揭开亵衣，一条缝……
一丝微风吹动……
吴谦迅速低下头去，只一眼……便把局面掌握。
虽鲜血沾满大地，但陨石坑依旧清晰可见，只匆匆一瞥，管中窥豹也可见一斑。
“还是个大碗！”
“确实有点可惜了……”
吴谦不光没受打击，反而信心暴涨。
凭借自己前世积累的见识，过硬的技术，若再加上这旷世奇迹的天材地宝……
提升境界刻不容缓！
先补个觉再说……
尚膳监内，范统罕见的大发雷霆。
大堂内一片狼藉，基本找不到完整之物，都被范统摔了个粉碎。
盛怒之下，连送信的朱小麦也未能幸免，背靠墙壁跌坐在地，嘴角残留着未干的血迹。
“废物！”
“饭桶！”
范统大声喝骂道，
“尚膳监全是饭桶！”
范统怎么能不生气，一群人风风火火去抓人，回来却说人被抓了。
更何况，被抓的还是自己侄儿！
“连个人都看不住，咱家要你们何用！”
朱小麦捂住胸口，艰难爬起身，劝道，
“首领息怒，眼下最重要是先把人救出来，范岱还能少吃点苦头。”
“还用的着你说？”
范统没好气的说道，
“我早就差人去要人，但孙满堂那王八蛋，一点面子都不给，谁知道抽什么风！”
朱小麦倒是知道抽什么风，就范岱骂的那些话，孙满堂没直接杀人，就已经给天大的面子了。
但现在不是说这些的时候，朱小麦只能继续献计，
content_en:
After finishing what needed to be persuaded and what needed to be said, Wu Hou left silently, leaving enough space for Wu Qian to calm down.
Wu Qian was indeed a little confused, so he even forgot to say hello when Wu Wuhou left.
Since he woke up, he only knew that he was in excruciating pain day and night, but he had never seen the wound.
Afraid of being unable to bear the stimulation of visual impact.
After listening to Wu Hou's words, Wu Qian's mind started to move.
We must face ourselves and our scars!
After preparing himself mentally, Wu Hou looked forward and slowly opened the front swing.
Slowly untie your belt,
Gently let go of your pants,
Slightly uncover the obscene clothes, a slit...
A slight breeze blows...
Wu Qian quickly lowered his head and took control of the situation with just one glance...
Although the ground is stained with blood, the crater is still clearly visible, and even with a quick glance, you can see something like a leopard peeking through a tube.
“It’s still a big bowl!”
"It's really a pity..."
Not only was Wu Qian not affected, but his confidence soared.
Relying on the knowledge accumulated in his previous life, excellent skills, and if coupled with this unparalleled miracle of natural materials and earthly treasures...
There is no time to delay in improving your realm!
Let’s catch up on some sleep first…
——————
In Shangshan Prison, Fan Tong was extremely angry.
The lobby was in a mess, and almost nothing could be found intact. Fan Tong smashed everything into pieces.
In a rage, even Zhu Maimai, who delivered the letter, was not spared. He fell to the ground with his back against the wall, with wet blood remaining on the corner of his mouth.
"Trash!"
"Rice bucket!"
Fan Tong yelled and cursed,
"All the Shangshang supervisors are losers!"
How could Fan Tong not be angry? A group of people went to arrest people in a hurry, but came back and said that they had been arrested.
What's more, the one who was arrested was his nephew!
"If you can't even look down on someone, what use does our family have for you!"
Zhu Xiaomai covered his chest, climbed up with difficulty, and advised,
"Chief, calm down. The most important thing right now is to rescue the people first. Fan Dai can also suffer less."
"Is it still useful?"
Fan Tong said angrily,
"I've sent people to ask for him a long time ago, but that bastard Sun Mantang doesn't give him any face, who knows what he's going to do!"
Zhu Xiaomai knew what was going on. According to Fan Dai's scolding words, Sun Mantang had already given Tian a great deal of face by not directly killing anyone.
But now is not the time to talk about this. Zhu Mai can only continue to offer suggestions.
